notes.title: Update 1/10/2021
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*]You may now recover removed overlays via the "Recover" Button, note that this will not recover DELETED overlays
[list]
[*]This can also be accomplished very simply via the native windows file explorer by moving overlays from the "removed" directory to the "overlays" directory, you can find your overlays and removed overlays at [b]"*\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\CustomCross\\overlays"[/b]
[/list]
[*]Added a new optional hotkey that allows you to change overlays on the fly.  Press the hotkey to advance to the next overlay in your list in a circular fashion.  You may set this in the settings menu.
[*]Added a "Reset" button to the settings page which will allow you to reset your settings to the default
[*]A few small UI and bug fixes
[/list]

Note that your current settings file may be regenerated.

Please report any bugs/issues in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1368630/discussions/1/]bug report forum[/url].
Thanks and enjoy
